question: Why is intellect principle itself sufficient?
premises: That indeed may be intellect principle.
What need of other imagined gunas?
This is not obstructed by cause-form reflection.
inference: Intellect principle itself may be sufficient, without other imagined gunas, and is not obstructed by cause-form reflection.
plain_english: That indeed may be the intellect principle; what need of other imagined gunas? It is not obstructed by cause-form reflection.
